Cisco Sys (CSCO) Holder Bank Of The Ozarks Cut Holding; Micron Technology (MU) Stake Held by Central Asset Investments & Management Holdings Hk Ltd
June 11, 2018 - By Evgen Dobrzhanskiy
Central Asset Investments & Management Holdings Hk Ltd increased its stake in Micron Technology Inc (MU) by 10.72% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Central Asset Investments & Management Holdings Hk Ltd bought 69,500 shares as the company’s stock rose 27.87% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 717,957 shares of the technology company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $37.43M, up from 648,457 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Central Asset Investments & Management Holdings Hk Ltd who had been investing in Micron Technology Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $71.94B market cap company. The stock increased 1.04% or $0.64 during the last trading session, reaching $62.03. About 10.71M shares traded. Micron Technology, Inc. (NASDAQ:MU) has risen 108.46% since June 11, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 95.89% the S&P500.
